name: Recraft V4.1 Utility Pro SVG
description: Generate detailed, high-resolution SVG vector graphics from text prompts with a general-purpose model, scalable to any size for print and large-scale design work.

name: Recraft V4.1 Utility SVG
description: Generate production-ready SVG vector graphics from text prompts with a general-purpose model suited for a wide range of design and illustration tasks.

name: Recraft V4.1 SVG

name: Recraft V4 Pro
description: Recraft V4 Pro generates high-resolution, art-directed images at 2048px+ with strong composition, text rendering, and design taste. Built for print and production work.

name: Recraft V4 Pro SVG
description: Generate detailed, production-ready SVG vector graphics from text prompts with fine geometry, scalable to any size for print and design work.

name: Recraft V4 SVG
description: Generate production-ready SVG vector graphics from text prompts with clean geometry, structured layers, and editable paths.

name: Beam 1.0 501B A23B
description: Beam-1.0-501B-A23B is Reflection AI's open-weights mixture-of-experts model with 501B total parameters and 23B active parameters, built for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads.

name: RunwayML Aleph 2
description: RunwayML's video editing model. Edit one frame to update your whole video, make changes across multiple shots, and work with up to 30 seconds of video. Supports keyframe-guided editing for precise control over specific moments in the clip.

name: RunwayML Gen-4.5
description: RunwayML's video generation model supporting both text-to-video and image-to-video with customizable duration, aspect ratio, and content moderation controls.

name: Inkling
description: Inkling is Thinking Machines' open-weights hybrid reasoning model, built on a mixture-of-experts architecture. It reasons by default, exposing its chain-of-thought as leading thinking content blocks, with reasoning effort tunable via a Tinker-specific output_config.effort parameter. Available through Tinker's beta Anthropic Messages-compatible endpoint alongside tool use, streaming, and multi-turn conversations. Currently intended for low-traffic testing and internal use rather than high-throughput production deployments; prompt caching, citations, and audio input are not supported through this endpoint.

name: Inkling 256K
description: The 256K-context variant of Inkling, Thinking Machines' open-weights hybrid reasoning MoE model. Same hybrid reasoning, tool-use, and streaming support as the base model, with an extended context window for longer conversations and documents. Currently intended for low-traffic testing and internal use rather than high-throughput production deployments.

name: Starlight Fast 2
description: Topaz Labs Starlight Fast 2 (slf-2) enhances and upscales source video to 1080p or 4K with faster processing than Starlight Precise. It is designed for video restoration workflows where turnaround time is important.

name: Starlight Precise 2.6
description: Topaz Labs Starlight Precise 2.6 (slp-2.6) is a video enhancement model that upscales and restores low-quality source video to 1080p or 4K. The quality-focused variant of the Starlight family, prioritizing detail reconstruction over speed. Billed using provider-reported processing credits.

name: Jev
description: Jev is TypeSafe's structured evaluation model. It evaluates one state against typed Noul, Choice, and Score questions and returns calibrated answers with probabilities and confidence.

name: Jev 1.14
description: Jev 1.14 is TypeSafe's structured evaluation model. It evaluates one state against typed Noul, Choice, Score, and Box questions and returns calibrated answers with probabilities and confidence. Image inputs and Box questions are beta and dreamer-ready, not recommended for production.

name: Pareto
description: Pareto is Unbiased's blended AI model. It engages multiple language models in parallel for each request, synthesizes one answer, and supports text and vision inputs through a single API response.

name: Vidu Q3 Pro
description: Vidu Q3 Pro is a high-quality video generation model supporting text-to-video, image-to-video, and start/end-frame-to-video workflows with audio and up to 16-second clips.

name: Vidu Q3 Turbo
description: Vidu Q3 Turbo is a faster version of Vidu Q3 optimized for lower latency video generation while maintaining audio support and up to 16-second clips.

name: Grok 4.20 Non-Reasoning
description: xAI's Grok 4.20 non-reasoning model. Skips the thinking trace for fast, single-pass responses while keeping the same training as the reasoning variant.

name: Grok 4.20 Reasoning
description: xAI's Grok 4.20 reasoning model. Uses extended thinking to work through complex problems, returning a reasoning trace alongside the final answer.

name: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent
description: xAI's Grok 4.20 multi-agent model with a 2M-token context window. Multiple agents collaborate in parallel to perform deep research tasks, with function calling, structured outputs, and reasoning capabilities.

name: Grok 4.3
description: xAI's Grok 4.3 model with a 1M-token context window and strong agentic tool calling with minimal hallucinations. Accepts text and image inputs, and supports function calling, structured outputs, and configurable reasoning effort (none, low, medium, high).

name: Grok 4.5
description: xAI's Grok 4.5, a frontier model built for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work. Accepts text and image inputs, and supports function calling, structured outputs, and configurable reasoning effort (low, medium, high).

name: Grok 4.6
description: xAI's Grok 4.6, a flagship reasoning model for coding, agentic tasks, and visual work. Accepts text and image inputs, and supports function calling and structured outputs.

name: Grok 4.7
description: xAI's Grok 4.7, a frontier reasoning model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work. Accepts text and image inputs, and supports function calling, structured outputs, and configurable reasoning effort (low, medium, high, xhigh).

name: Grok Imagine Image
description: xAI's Grok Imagine image model. Generates and edits images from text and reference-image inputs with configurable aspect ratio and resolution.

name: Grok Imagine Image 2.0
description: xAI's Grok Imagine Image 2.0 is a precise image generation and editing model for creative work, with strong instruction following, typography, layout, and reference-image preservation.

name: Grok Imagine Image Quality
description: xAI's higher-fidelity text-to-image model optimized for sharper details, more accurate compositions, and stronger text rendering. Supports image editing via reference images and masks. Trades speed for quality compared to grok-imagine-image. Default output at 2k resolution.

name: Grok Imagine Video
description: xAI's video generation model. Generates, edits, and extends videos from text and image inputs with native synchronized audio including dialogue, sound effects, and music. Supports multiple creative modes (normal, fun, custom).

name: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Preview
description: xAI's next-generation video generation model. Generates, edits, and extends videos from text and image inputs. Supports multiple aspect ratios and resolutions with improved quality over the previous generation.

name: Grok STT
description: xAI's Grok speech-to-text model. Transcribes audio files into text across 25 languages with word-level timestamps, multichannel transcription, speaker diarization, and key-term biasing.

name: Grok TTS
description: xAI's Grok text-to-speech model. Generates high-fidelity spoken audio in 5 expressive voices (eve, ara, rex, sal, leo) with 20+ supported languages. Supports inline speech tags for laughter, whispers, and pauses.

name: Grok Voice
description: xAI's real-time voice conversation model with low-latency audio input and output streaming.

name: bge-small-en-v1.5

name: flux-1-schnell

name: flux-2-dev

name: flux-2-klein-4b

name: flux-2-klein-9b

name: stable-diffusion-xl-lightning
description: SDXL-Lightning is a lightning-fast text-to-image generation model. It can generate high-quality 1024px images in a few steps.

name: clef
description: Clef is a 27B multimodal decision model that turns a state and a schema of typed questions into decisions. It reads the state as text, JSON, images, or video, and returns a probability for every allowed option of every question.

name: phonellm-mini-alpha-2

name: embeddinggemma-300m

This model was trained with data in 100+ spoken languages.

name: gemma-4-26b-a4b-it
